chapters.title: A Call for Help
chapters.summary: Dwarven messenger Roric asks the Dragon Rider Order to aid Khazad-Throm; after debate, the Order accepts and Alaric is chosen to lead.

chapters.title: Kingdom under the Mountain
chapters.summary: Alaric, Caradoc, Eloran and a dozen Dragon Riders reach Khazad-Throm, meet King Thordal, and learn the character and scale of dwarven civilization.

chapters.title: The Problem
chapters.summary: Khazad-Throm explains the goblin and troll war; Alaric and Eloran negotiate a formal mutual-defense alliance and prepare for a joint campaign.

chapters.title: Battle of Durin's Chasm
chapters.summary: Dwarven shield walls and Dragon Riders combine their different strengths to hold a major chokepoint and defeat a goblin assault.

chapters.title: Battle of Broken Shard Passage
chapters.summary: Alaric leads a dangerous flanking force through an abandoned mining passage, turning a goblin counterattack into a rout.

chapters.title: Battle of the Goblin Burrow
chapters.summary: The allied army assaults the goblin stronghold in small tunnel-fighting formations; Alaric kills Goblin King Grishnak with help from Bhor and Gawain.

chapters.title: Victory
chapters.summary: Khazad-Throm celebrates its survival and King Thordal visits the Valley, where the alliance is publicly affirmed.

chapters.title: Steel and Stone
chapters.summary: The alliance becomes permanent through an embassy, trade, mining cooperation, a dwarven settlement in the Valley, and mutual exchange of expertise.
